title: Our English Class
text:
Our English class has thirty students. Twenty students are women and ten students are men. Most students are between twenty and forty years old. Each student comes to class on Monday and Thursday.

Our teacher is forty-five years old. She has more than fifty English books at home. Each lesson is ninety minutes long. We read about eighty new words every week.

questions.text: How many men are in the class?
What can we guess about the teacher?
options: She knows a lot about English
She teaches only one lesson a week

questions.text: Why do the students probably study English hard?
options: They want to speak English well

vocabulary.definition: people who are learning at a school or in a class
in the middle of two numbers, times or places
every one of a group, considered one by one
a period of time when a teacher teaches a subject

paragraph_translations: İngilizce sınıfımızda otuz öğrenci var. Yirmi öğrenci kadın, on öğrenci erkek. Çoğu öğrenci yirmi ile kırk yaş arasında. Her öğrenci pazartesi ve perşembe günü derse gelir.
Öğretmenimiz kırk beş yaşında. Evinde elliden fazla İngilizce kitabı var. Her ders doksan dakika sürer. Her hafta yaklaşık seksen yeni kelime okuruz.
